# @vllnt/convex-push

> Push notifications sent straight from a Convex backend to Apple (APNs), Google (FCM HTTP v1) and browser push services (Web Push), as a Convex component. Device registry, durable send queue, retries, dead-device cleanup and an encrypted provider-token cache, with no relay service.

`@vllnt/convex-push` is a publishable Convex component. Keys are bound to the component as environment variables at mount and never stored. Hosts extend it with a custom provider (one action), a delivery hook (one mutation) and `rawJson` payload fields. Requires `convex@^1.47.0` and uses `@convex-dev/workpool` and `@convex-dev/rate-limiter`. Version 0.1.0 is a canary: delivery to real devices is not verified yet.

For coding agents: this file, the API reference and the changelog are bundled in the npm package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-push/`, next to the source in `src/`. They match the installed version. Read them before writing code against this package.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md): Overview, installation with env binding, usage, extension points, security model and limits
- [API Reference](./docs/API.md): Package exports, `Push` class methods, validators, provider answers, error codes and the delivery lifecycle
- [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes
- [Contributing](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-push/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, validation commands, and release workflow notes

## Examples

These files are on GitHub `main` and may be newer than the installed version.

- [Example host app](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-push/blob/main/example/convex/example.ts): Two mounts, the four platforms, a custom webhook provider and a delivery hook
- [Example tests](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-push/blob/main/example/convex/example.test.ts): End-to-end behaviour with `convex-test` and recorded provider responses
